material.description: blocked_by: upstream-wireweave-direct-candidates. Live checks: git ls-remote https://github.com/AnEntrypoint/wireweave.git HEAD main returns a71f179cc5352964bc014deea166969938705e61 for both, which equals the current pin in js/client/play.html:11 and .github/workflows/ci.yml:4194 (codesearch dispatch 1792506298093-1405-ff79e8a49e6eaaaf and 1792506300442-1407-f9b832be5ca8f000). jsDelivr for that pin returns 200. The row's candidate gathering changes (host candidates across interfaces, mDNS handling, srflx on STUN list) exist in no upstream commit we can see, and the row says no wireweave source is in this repo (spoint/vendor/wireweave is an empty submodule). So the pin cannot move to a commit that carries the change; the edit has no target. Needs an upstream wireweave commit implementing the candidate changes, then a pin bump here and the browser-direct CI witness. No file edited, no commit pushed.
material.subject: Blocker: no upstream wireweave commit to pin (pin a71f179 is upstream main HEAD)
material.witness: gh api: wireweave origin main is a71f179 and the oscraft pin for js/client/vendor/wireweave is a71f179, so the pin is current. Premise that no upstream commit exists is moot. Stale.
